paragraphs.source_en: In the first month of the fourth year of Keichō, Toyotomi Hideyori moved into Osaka as planned. Kita no Mandokoro, who had until then lived in the main castle, moved to the western compound, while Lady Yodo and the seven-year-old Hideyori took up residence in the inner quarters, becoming the true masters of Osaka Castle in name and fact. As a regent, Maeda Toshiie naturally moved into the castle as well. Tokugawa Ieyasu, who was overseeing the government, escorted Hideyori to Osaka and then returned to Fushimi.
